name: Egg-Free Banana Oat Muffins
ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats, ground into flour
2 tbsp ground flaxseed mixed with 5 tbsp water (flax egg)
¼ cup plain unsweetened soy yogurt
1 tsp baking powder and ½ tsp cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line 4 muffin cups.
Stir the flaxseed with water and rest for 5 minutes until gelled.
Mix the bananas, flax egg, yogurt, oil and vanilla; fold in the oat flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt.
Bake for 20–22 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes.
note: Sweetened only with bananas; makes 4 muffins, so 2 per serving.
